{{Top|leg}}
The '''blaster wars''' was a commercial competition between [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], and several other companies to attain the unofficial title of "blaster king." The blaster wars started when BlasTech created the [[DL-22 blaster pistol]] in direct response to Merr-Sonn's [[DD6 blaster pistol/Legends|DD6 blaster pistol]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

BlasTech won the blaster wars when they produced the [[T-6 heavy blaster pistol]], the most powerful [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] ever manufactured. It was in direct response to SoroSuub's [["Renegade" heavy blaster pistol/Legends|Renegade heavy blaster pistol]], but once BlasTech demostrated the power of the T-6, Merr-Sonn ceded the competition to their rivals.<ref name="GFT" />
